description: Minister of Transport Highways Ports and Civil Aviation - Merchant Shipping Act. No.52 of 1971 Merchant Shipping (Non. Convention Vessel) Regulations No. 01 of 2024
categorisation: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister under the Merchant Shipping Act, establishing new legal requirements for non-convention vessels. It creates a regulatory framework with compliance requirements, certificates, and penalties for violations, which falls squarely under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5) rather than government personnel/structure changes.
